result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends on your country, number of employees, and whether you want payroll to integrate with your accounting software.

If you're operating in Australia, I'd focus on software that handles **STP Phase 2 reporting, PAYG withholding, superannuation, award rates, leave entitlements and Single Touch Payroll compliance**\.

I wouldn't automatically choose a US-focused product like Gusto or QuickBooks Payroll for an Australian business.

## My top Australian payroll software picks

![Xero Review: Beautiful cloud accounting for small businesses](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/zGt9HgpMco6i_cEW4Fs2z4PfaYnsmZs5tPfBUXsnllkv1BJub0fQjmBDPN6Tj_rhsmDrvtCTN1sy6j8MlElBMhgWnLS-E6YtgVna7212YJZ450WRilWWBa0zxHPN0xUPvL1bReO96RNQcOlASZXYIFWdl7ErEK4L1kcoJAb3DRFhlKyCQY0Myx8ZoJTQoUTJ?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Xero Payroll**

(Best overall for most small businesses)

- Easy payroll and accounting integration.
- STP Phase 2 reporting.
- Leave, payslips and super management.
- Particularly good if your accountant uses Xero.

Payroll included in Australian accounting plans.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/au/)

---

![Employment Hero - Which HR Software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hoOMaIHHE1BVK8wWyswfFUWF-4zNLm2VTTf8I0IsZi71QvwwVg013JN6PZd_JzmKlLo5GMH1Nn9Dlq8Awe3_MYWQTya_RX2YJlpU2kxq0LmTpktkVrYam4C6Jqjid1iaOedcQ7rhD-uZbRDBcKqCEBszhJOC_eRUB4bTTF7gnOKcGZ7dKIuzDzdg-ruuRgJy?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Employment Hero**

(Best for award-based employees)

- Modern Award interpretation.
- Rostering and timesheets.
- Payroll, onboarding and HR.
- Particularly useful for hospitality, retail and shift workers.

Payroll pricing starts around \$10 per employee/month, with a 10-user minimum.

[Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/au/)

---

![MYOB - Features, Reviews & Pricing (February 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/RSnJXDEAckMg49Z3Uyl1ySpGe5Mf5xY-fiHvWrkutyMlRVsk_cizHWnHbb0_8J0spngX92NOecbYb0xtPztOW_1U5_j589rcfR6e_7DzDwZO-F8qM8BNDHiplH9bI1r3qal9-SnHWVHGyS5SP06Y1atDJc1eUMWI1ht7KCGJtRhy8le1UHOPMDyYDZIt-Ehu?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. MYOB**

- Good standalone payroll option.
- Suitable for small teams.
- Strong Australian accounting functionality.

Payroll Only: approximately \$20/month for up to four employees from November 2026.

[MYOB website](https://www.myob.com/au/)

---

![Reckon Payroll 2026 Pricing, Features, Reviews & Alternatives | GetApp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ACef1V9QbM8Y3LxjLzJIQV-TfChUBjwyyx7W6AOhVMywuWusbhYulcZYBn3S8A-J1ZSIIaQtu8WMi3CVnQm3fE7mKMbBw3Beo_sQTtWxx5CDDP34nqzqL6m70W1jmud24Hdj0BDI4_JPvo8A-h8b5n6w-92zDw-PxjtUuoZZ2u15XApkZg7xxx4sYiZVnXkz?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Reckon Payroll**

- Budget-friendly payroll.
- Good for micro businesses.
- Straightforward employee payments and reporting.

Approximately \$16/month for up to four employees.

[Reckon website](https://www.reckon.com/au/)

## Which one would I choose?

My starting recommendation would be\:

- **Xero\:** If you want simple payroll and accounting together.
- **Employment Hero\:** If you have casual staff, shift workers or complicated award rates.
- **MYOB\:** If you have only a few employees and want affordable standalone payroll.

search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
